shortDescription: Member check-in result route with state-based rendering.
fullDescription: Renders the member check-in result screen on the root route and selects the visible state from the optional searchParams.state value. Supports the success-active-member, payment-method-invalid-past-due, and membership-cancelled-access-denied states through the shared member check-in result view component.

shortDescription: Reusable member check-in result screen component.
fullDescription: Displays a gym member check-in result layout with a lightweight application header, interactive member number search row, hero status banner, member details section, amenity cards, and a full-width result footer. Accepts state, member, memberNumber, defaultMemberNumber, onMemberNumberChange, and onSearch props so the same component can render success-active-member, payment-method-invalid-past-due, and membership-cancelled-access-denied states while preserving state-specific member data, titles, labels, icons, amenity styling, and footer messaging.
